profile.headline: Software Engineer II - Ruby on Rails
profile.summary:
Software Engineer whose passion for programming started from going to Meetups and loving the problem solving aspect of coding. Graduating from a 14 week intensive coding bootcamp where I learned 3 MVC including Python with Django, Ruby on Rails, and M.E.A.N. Stack. 


Technical Skills

-Frameworks
Flask, Django, Ruby on Rails 4/5, M.E.A.N. Stack

- Front-End
HTML5, CSS3, Vue.js 2, Angular.js 4, JQuery, Javascript

-Back-End
Python, Ruby, Javascript (ES5, ES6), Express.js, Node.js, Mongoose.js, Nuxt.js

-Databases
NoSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, SQLite, Sequelize

-Software
Docker(in training), Windows, Linux, Git, Bash, MYSQL workbench

projects.title: Relief Search
projects.description: Relief Share is an online checking database where individuals can upload photos of loved ones missing from disaster events. A user uploads a photo of their missing person to our application. Then, using Microsofts Facial Recognition API we search through the database and see if the missing person, or first responders uploaded a picture of the missing individual. If the missing person's image is found in the database both uploaders receive confirmation of their loved ones safety. Relief Search connects family's in a time of crisis.
